event_name: Document 54 Date 12 September 2021 Time 16:09 2021 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Failed to leave one car width and caused a collision with car 5 in turn 4.
offence: Breach of Article 2 b) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 31 was defending his position approaching Turn 4. Car 5 pulled alongside to the right. Having earlier defended his position off line, the driver of Car 31 failed to leave a car width between his own car and the edge of the track on the approach to the corner (as is required in the regulation) and caused the collision with Car 5.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 31 Collision With Car 5 In Turn 4
